title: Baseten joins Hugging Face as an inference provider for open models
friendlyTitle: Hugging Face adds another way to run open AI models
summary: Hugging Face added Baseten to its Inference Providers, initially for conversational and text-generation models including Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-5.2. Developers can route requests through Hugging Face billing or bring a Baseten key using the Hub interface and standard Python or JavaScript clients.
friendlySummary: Developers can now use Baseten to run several popular open models through Hugging Face tools and billing.
whyItMatters: A common model interface makes it easier to compare hosts or add capacity without rewriting an application. Teams should still benchmark latency, regional availability, pricing and data-handling terms because the same model can behave differently across serving platforms.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It becomes easier to change or compare AI hosting services. Check speed, cost and privacy before choosing one for real work.
